title: Naturality of concrete decalage representative cohomology classes
statement: Let \(C\) be abelian, \(t:U\to V\) a filtered chain map, \(p,q,r\in\mathbb Z\), \(r\ge2\), and \(n=p+q\). Let \(\rho:R_r^{p,n}(U)\to R_r^{p,n}(V)\) be a map between the original cycle representative pullbacks whose composite with the ambient inclusion is the ambient inclusion followed by \(t^n\). For the concrete class maps \(c_r\) [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-page-data], one has \(\rho c_r(V)=c_r(U)H^n(t_{[q,q+r-1]})\), where the interval map is the prescribed quotient map of the decalage tower [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-tower]. No epimorphism assumption on \(\rho\) is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplexDecalageRepresentativeClass_naturality
    {U V : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (t : U ⟶ V)
    (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (ρ : (U.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r : C) ⟶
      (V.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r : C))
    (hρ : ρ ≫ (V.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r).arrow ≫
        (V.filtration.step p).arrow.f (p + q) =
      (U.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r).arrow ≫
        (U.filtration.step p).arrow.f (p + q) ≫ t.hom.f (p + q)) :
    ρ ≫ filteredComplexDecalageRepresentativeClass V p q r hr =
      filteredComplexDecalageRepresentativeClass U p q r hr ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (DecreasingFiltration.decalageTowerIntervalMap t (q : EInt)
            ((q + (r - 1) : ℤ) : EInt) (by simp; omega)).τ₃ (p + q)
